context_summary: F87 Liga Foil Price Differentiation — Foil cards are getting the same price as non-foil. The Liga provider parser has basic foil section detection (_extract_foil_section) but the prices are not stored or displayed separately. Need to: (1) research Liga HTML structure for foil vs non-foil separation, (2) enhance parser to reliably capture lowest foil price, (3) store foil prices as distinct observations (is_foil flag on PriceObservationRow or separate external_id), (4) display foil vs non-foil prices in frontend. Single feature, clear scope.

options_considered.description: Proceed with plan-feature for F87 — full foil differentiation pipeline.
pros: Clear user need — foil prices are wrong
Liga parser already has foil detection skeleton
cons: Requires Liga HTML research (may discover unexpected structure)
Delays fix for a known problem
Parser already has foil detection — just needs refinement

rationale: The Liga parser already has _extract_foil_section infrastructure. The research phase can be Wave 0 (T01) with implementation in Wave 1. No reason to split into separate features.
